summary: Santacruz Silver Mining Ltd., via its Bolivian subsidiary San Lucas, filed a Form 6-K press release announcing the fourth tranche of a Bs 70 million unsecured promissory note offering in Bolivian capital markets. The notes carry a 10.9985% annual interest rate, mature July 18, 2027, and were fully subscribed by institutional investors. This replaces a prior tranche, keeping the program at its Bs 140 million authorized cap. The transaction is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation; no equity, acquisition, or strategic event is involved.
